capabilities.name: Authentication
duplication_risks: Multi-application identity and tenant-membership contract must be verified before reuse.
consolidation_opportunities: Verify shared identity/auth contract before application integration.

capabilities.name: Agent Runtime and Orchestration
duplication_risks: AFUZA.ID Ops docs describe command/orchestration responsibilities that may overlap Hermes/AFUZA AI; ownership boundary needs explicit contract.
consolidation_opportunities: Define API/control-plane contracts between AFUZA.ID, Ops and AFUZA AI before product implementation.

capabilities.name: Organization / User Management
consolidation_opportunities: Define portable organization/user contract only after source-of-truth review.

capabilities.name: Lead Discovery
duplication_risks: Discovery scripts and workflow specifications may overlap.
consolidation_opportunities: Expose discovery through explicit API/event contracts to approved consumers.

capabilities.name: Lead Scoring
duplication_risks: Baseline, V2 and current-code weights/thresholds differ.
consolidation_opportunities: Record one approved versioned scoring policy after business decision.

capabilities.name: Lead Qualification
duplication_risks: Scoring qualifies differently in historical docs and present implementation.
consolidation_opportunities: Separate evidence eligibility gates from score threshold and approve both.

capabilities.name: Approval Queue
duplication_risks: Core Ops approvals and lead-specific approval records have distinct contracts.
consolidation_opportunities: Expose approval state/context to consumers while retaining domain-specific decisions.

capabilities.name: Outbound Outreach
duplication_risks: WF03/WF05 describe sending while current Ops policies set execution_enabled=false.
consolidation_opportunities: Keep orchestration canonical in Shared Acquisition Engine and require approved contracts.

capabilities.name: WhatsApp
duplication_risks: WAHA and Wablas provider instructions coexist; production policy is unclear.
consolidation_opportunities: Marketing Agency consumes shared provider adapters; no direct provider implementation in the agency repository.

capabilities.name: Acquisition Analytics
duplication_risks: KPI definitions may differ by workflow generation.
consolidation_opportunities: Standardize event definitions and denominators before portfolio comparison.

capabilities.name: Landing Page Generation
duplication_risks: Product Factory architecture could duplicate or replace AFUZA.ID generation; boundary unresolved.
consolidation_opportunities: Marketing Agency consumes the Afuza Landing Page Production capability through a defined contract.

capabilities.name: Publishing
duplication_risks: Separate publishing targets/security contracts may not be interchangeable.
consolidation_opportunities: Reuse contracts only after tenant, approval and deployment target boundaries are specified.

capabilities.name: AI Generation
duplication_risks: Provider/router and workflow architecture differ between product docs.
consolidation_opportunities: Consume shared AI generation through explicit contracts; do not duplicate provider logic.

capabilities.name: Payments / Billing
duplication_risks: Future schema references are not proof of implementation.
consolidation_opportunities: KlodHost owns its hosting billing domain; shared usage/quota remains platform-owned.

capabilities.name: Asset Storage
duplication_risks: Creative OS storage is explicitly unprovisioned and must remain isolated.
consolidation_opportunities: Evaluate only after Creative OS infrastructure is approved.

capabilities.name: Observability
duplication_risks: No common telemetry contract or service owner evidenced.
consolidation_opportunities: Inventory per-project health/audit signals before selecting shared service.

capabilities.name: Audit Trail
duplication_risks: Different audit stores and domain boundaries may exist.
consolidation_opportunities: Compare event schema and retention policy before consolidation.

capabilities.name: Autonomous Execution Control
duplication_risks: Ecosystem control remains a portfolio-local AX-02 capability; consumer rollout not yet planned.
consolidation_opportunities: Adopt the standard per project after AX-02 and AX-03.
